issue_context.body:
### What's the Problem?

Properties window lacks the Compatibility section.

### Solution/Idea

```markdown
I have an example below that show's the amount of sections that Files UWP currently lacks compared to the standard explorer.

example: https://i.imgur.com/BaZrmHG.png
```


### Alternatives

```markdown
⠀
```


### Priorities

_No response_

### Files Version

v1.9.17.0

### Windows Version

Windows 11 21H2 22000.100

### Additional comment

```markdown
Submitting this issue as a feature request and not a bug as the properties window is working as intended.

My only issue with the lack of the compatibility section or any other missing section is how tedious it is to open the file explorer property window especially seeing as I've gone through with 'Replacing File Explorer with Files' so in file explorer every time I navigate a folder Files opens up instead.
```
